label: The esse-cause bridge, via distinct actual dependence
description: The derivation of STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND in Round2Grounding.esseCauseGroundViaDependence applies the dependence-to-grounding bridge only to c and x with c distinct from x. This sibling takes the weaker distinct-relata version of that bridge, with the other three premises unchanged. It therefore does not commit DependsForBeing to irreflexivity, which the unrestricted bridge does in combination with grounding-to-priority and priority requiring nonmutual dependence (reflexiveUnrestrictedExcludesActualConcreta). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
